note: Researched from state statutes, the NMHC 2026 rent control chart, state agencies and law firm summaries. Notice periods marked medium confidence come mostly from one aggregator. Not legal advice: check current law before underwriting.

AL.rent_note: State law (Ala. Code 11-80-8.1) bars local rent control.

AK.rent_note: No preemption law and no local rent control; cities' power to adopt it is limited.

AZ.rent_note: State law (A.R.S. 33-1329) bars local rent control and mandatory inclusionary zoning.

AR.rent_note: State law (Ark. Code 14-16-601) bars local rent control.
AR.notice_note: 3-day notice to quit for a civil eviction; other routes use 5 or 10 days.

CA.rent_note: AB 1482: 5% + regional CPI, max 10%, through 2030. Exempts buildings under 15 years old and most single-family homes and condos not owned by corporations. 30+ cities have stricter local control.
CA.just_cause_note: Statewide just cause after 12 months, with the same exemptions; many cities are stricter.

CO.rent_note: State law (C.R.S. 38-12-301) bars local rent control; repeal bills failed in 2023 and 2024.
CO.just_cause_note: HB24-1098: cause needed to evict or not renew after 12+ months; some owner-occupied, short-term and employer housing exempt.
CO.notice_note: Shorter for some small owner-occupied rentals.

CT.rent_note: Courts bar local rent caps, but towns' fair rent commissions can hear complaints and order excessive rents cut.
CT.just_cause_note: Only tenants 62+ or disabled in buildings of 5+ units (not re-verified).
CT.notice_note: 3-day notice to quit after a 9-day grace period.

DE.rent_note: No preemption, but no locality has rent control; a Wilmington proposal failed in 2025.

DC.rent_note: Rent stabilization on most pre-1976 buildings: CPI-W + 2%, max 10% (about 4.1% for 2026). Some exemptions apply.
DC.notice_note: RENTAL Act (about Dec 31, 2025) cut this from 30 to 10 days; no filing unless at least $600 is owed.

FL.rent_note: The Live Local Act (2023) removed local power to adopt rent control.

GA.rent_note: State law (O.C.G.A. 44-7-19) bars local rent regulation.
GA.notice_note: 3 business days for leases signed or renewed on or after July 1, 2024.

HI.rent_note: No preemption and no local rent control.
HI.notice_note: 10 calendar days plus a mediation option in a pilot through Feb 4, 2028 (Act 278); was 5 business days.

ID.rent_note: State law (Idaho Code 55-306) bars local control of rent, fees or deposits.

IL.rent_note: The Rent Control Preemption Act (50 ILCS 825) covers home-rule cities, including Chicago.

IN.rent_note: State law (IC 32-31-1-20) bars local rent regulation and most other local landlord-tenant rules.

IA.rent_note: State law (Iowa Code 364.3, 331.304) bars city and county rent limits.

KS.rent_note: State law (K.S.A. 12-16,120) bars local rent control.

KY.rent_note: State law (KRS 65.875) reserves rent control to the legislature.
KY.notice_note: Only where the local government adopted the uniform landlord-tenant act; elsewhere no fixed period.

LA.rent_note: State law (La. R.S. 9:3258) and case law bar local rent control.
LA.notice_note: 5-day notice to vacate; the lease can waive it.

ME.rent_note: Portland caps increases at 70% of Boston-area CPI (2.2% for 2026); buildings after April 2020 exempt. No statewide cap.

MD.rent_note: Montgomery County: CPI + 3%, max 6%, 23-year rolling new-build exemption. Prince George's: CPI + 3%, max 6%, post-2000 units exempt. Also Takoma Park.
MD.just_cause_note: No statewide requirement found; check county and city rules.
MD.notice_note: Notice of intent to file must use the Judiciary's form.

MA.rent_note: Banned since 1994 (Ch. 40P). In June 2026 the SJC struck the rent control ballot question, so it is not on the Nov 2026 ballot.
MA.notice_note: 14-day notice to quit; tenants at will may cure within 10 days.

MI.rent_note: State law (MCL 123.411) bars local rent control.

MN.rent_note: St. Paul caps increases at 3% a year, with buildings after 2004 exempt (2025 change). Minneapolis is authorized but has adopted nothing.

MS.rent_note: State law (Miss. Code 21-17-5) bars city rent regulation without legislative approval.

MO.rent_note: State law (RSMo 441.043) bars local rent control, source-of-income rules and deposit limits.
MO.notice_note: No statutory waiting period; the landlord demands rent and can file.

MT.rent_note: State law (MCA 7-1-111) bars local rent control.

NE.rent_note: LB 266 (signed April 2025) bars local rent control, including in home-rule cities.

NV.rent_note: No preemption law and no local rent control; local power to adopt it is limited.

NH.rent_note: Courts bar local rent control (Girard v. Allenstown, 1981); there is no statute.
NH.just_cause_note: Most rentals need a listed cause, but 'other good cause' is broad. Owners of 3 or fewer single-family homes and owner-occupied 4-units or smaller are exempt.

NJ.rent_note: About 100 municipalities have rent control (including Newark, Jersey City and Hoboken); caps and exemptions vary by town.
NJ.just_cause_note: The Anti-Eviction Act covers most rentals; owner-occupied buildings with 2 or fewer rental units are exempt.
NJ.notice_note: No notice to quit needed for nonpayment; the tenant can generally cure by paying in full.

NM.rent_note: State law (NMSA 47-8A-1) bars local rent control, including in home-rule cities.

NY.rent_note: NYC rent stabilization (about 1M units) plus stabilization in parts of Nassau, Westchester, Rockland and Kingston. No statewide cap.
NY.just_cause_note: Good Cause Eviction applies in NYC and 19 opt-in localities (May 2026); raises above CPI + 5% (max 10%) are presumed unreasonable.

NC.rent_note: State law (G.S. 42-14.1) bars local rent control.
NC.notice_note: 10 days after a written demand for rent.

ND.rent_note: State law (N.D.C.C. 47-16-02.1) bars local rent control.

OH.rent_note: HB 430 (2022, ORC 5321.19) bars local rent control and rent stabilization.

OK.rent_note: State law (11 O.S. 14-101.1) bars municipal rent control.

OR.rent_note: 7% + CPI, max 10% (9.5% in 2026, 10% in 2027). Units under 15 years old are exempt; no increase in the first year. Local rent control is preempted.
OR.just_cause_note: After the first year, landlords need cause or a qualifying reason; most owe relocation pay for no-fault endings.
OR.notice_note: 10 days, or 13 if served earlier in the rental period.

PA.rent_note: No preemption law and no local rent control; cities' authority to adopt it without state approval is doubtful.
PA.notice_note: The lease can shorten or waive it.

RI.rent_note: No preemption, but no locality has rent control.
RI.notice_note: Only after rent is 15 days late.

SC.rent_note: State law (S.C. Code 27-39-60) bars local rent regulation.
SC.notice_note: No separate notice if the lease contains the statutory notice language.

SD.rent_note: State law (SDCL 6-1-13) bars local rent control.
SD.notice_note: Sources differ on whether this is a notice to quit or a wait after rent is due.

TN.rent_note: State law (T.C.A. 66-35-102) bars local rent control.
TN.notice_note: In counties under the uniform landlord-tenant act; elsewhere it follows the notice or lease.

TX.rent_note: Local rent control is barred except in a disaster with the governor's approval (Loc. Gov't Code 214.902).
TX.notice_note: The lease can set a different period. SB 38 (Jan 1, 2026) changed notice delivery and requires a pay-or-vacate option for first-time late payers.

UT.rent_note: State law (Utah Code 57-20-1) bars local rent and fee control.

VT.rent_note: No preemption law and no local rent control; local power to adopt it is limited.

VA.rent_note: Localities lack authority; 2026 bills to allow local rent caps (HB 278, SB 355) failed and went to study.
VA.notice_note: 14 days from July 1, 2026 (was 5); may revert in 2028 or later.

WA.rent_note: 7% + CPI, max 10% (9.683% in 2026, 10% in 2027). Units 12 years old or newer and owner-occupied 2- to 4-plexes are exempt; no increase in the first 12 months.
WA.just_cause_note: RCW 59.18.650 requires a listed cause for most terminations and non-renewals.
WA.notice_note: Mandatory state form; add 5 days if mailed.

WV.rent_note: No preemption law and no local rent control; local power to adopt it is limited.
WV.notice_note: No pre-suit notice; the landlord files and the court sets a hearing.

WI.rent_note: State law (Wis. Stat. 66.1015) bars local rent control and fee limits.
WI.notice_note: For month-to-month or leases of a year or less; longer leases need a longer notice.

WY.rent_note: No preemption, but no locality has rent control.
WY.notice_note: Rent must be 3 days late, then a 3-day notice.
